prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV/booth tanning or spray (sunless) tanning? Also what neighborhood or ZIP in Columbus, and do you want cheap/membership options or a higher-end salon?

If you want suggestions right away, I can search and list the top-rated salons near you — tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and which type of tanning you prefer.

Helpful tips for choosing the best salon
- Confirm the type of tanning (spray vs stand-up or lay-down UV booths) and which brand of spray solution they use (e.g., Norvell, Mystic) if you care about results/scent.
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews and photos for cleanliness and consistency.
- Ask about technician experience, whether spray tans are applied by a tech or machine, and whether they do a patch test for sensitivity.
- Inspect equipment condition and ask how often bulbs are changed (for UV booths).
- Compare pricing and packages, and check membership cancellation terms.
- Make sure they follow safety guidelines (eye protection, time limits) and offer pre/post tanning care instructions.

Tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and preferred tanning type and I’ll pull a short list of top-rated salons near you.
